regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative regime in Hong Kong: Banks (H + HK) lead with a 0.203 score margin over Energy, only 2 of 17 themes are eligible, and absorption is 0.48. Banks is eligible but unscorable (no ETF proxy), while the two scorable themes (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) rank 13th and 15th with negative scores and are ineligible. The gate_helps flag is true, but the dominant leader has no tradeable proxy, so most callable conviction is structurally suppressed.
emerging_watch: Watch Energy (H-shares) as a potential challenger to Banks: it ranks #2 (score 0.98, margin 0.203) and has a trend hurst_tag, but is currently ineligible. I am watching for Energy to turn eligible with a score exceeding Banks, which would be the first confirmed handoff in this one-narrative regime; until then Banks remains the leader.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible, top-ranked theme (score 1.183, durability_bar 0.54, hurst_tag mean-revert) and the regime is one-narrative with no confirmed challenger handoff. I lean overweight as a trend-discipline expression, not a return forecast: the absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge, and Banks is riding it. The mean-revert hurst tag and 0.385 breadth argue the move is intact but fragile.
evidence: eligible: true, rank: 1, score: 1.183 vs next 0.98
gate_helps: true on this market history
theses.dissent: Banks is unscorable with no ETF proxy, so the lean cannot be tracked against a clean instrument; it is effectively a notional view. The hurst_tag mean-revert and modest breadth (0.385) mean a shake-out could reverse the leadership quickly.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: This is one of only two scorable themes in the set (ETF proxy 3033.HK), but it ranks 13th with a negative score (-0.797), is ineligible, and has a low durability_bar (0.19) with a mean-revert tag. There is no trend-gate support, so a long lean would violate the one validated edge. Avoiding keeps capital away from an ineligible, negatively-scored theme until the absolute-trend gate flips it eligible.
evidence: gate_helps: true — ineligible means no trend support
theses.dissent: As a mean-revert theme at a low rank, it could bounce sharply in a broad risk-on rotation, especially if macro AI/tech headlines (dominant macro theme, n=10) spill into HK tech sentiment.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet moves to eligible status with a positive score before the check-by date

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: The second scorable theme (ETF proxy 3033.HK) ranks 15th with the most negative score of the tech complex (-1.037), is ineligible, durability_bar 0.18, and breadth 0.111. No detector leg supports a long: it fails the absolute-trend gate outright. Avoid until it re-enters eligible territory.
evidence: crowding_z: -0.85 — not crowded, but no trend support
theses.dissent: Platform megacaps are high-beta and could lead an aggressive rebound if China stimulus or tech policy headlines shift; avoiding them forfeits the bounce.
